expr: (async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));for(let i=0;i<150&&!(window.Defense&&document.querySelector('.df-canvas'));i++)await w(100);await w(500);const d=Defense,s=d.sim;s.L.slotsAt.forEach((p,i)=>{d.S.placeTower(s,i,'monkey')});s.gold=9999;s.towers.forEach(t=>{d.S.upgrade(s,t);d.S.upgrade(s,t)});for(let i=0;i<20000&&!s.over;i++){d.S.step(s,0.05);s.towers.forEach(t=>{t.cd=Math.min(t.cd,0)})}await w(2500);const m=document.querySelector('.df-modal');return '[1 打完第1關] 贏='+s.won+' 愛心='+s.hearts+' 結果畫面='+(m?m.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').slice(0,60):'沒有')+' 星數存檔='+JSON.stringify(Progress.get().stars)})()

(async()=>{const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));document.querySelector('#r-menu').click();await w(400);const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('.df-lv')];return '[2 回選關] 鎖住='+b.filter(x=>x.disabled).length+' 第1關='+b[0].textContent+' 第4關鎖='+b[3].disabled+' 總星='+document.querySelector('.df-sum').textContent})()
